description.value: The Millennium Sport Centre is a civic sports facility in Vancouver's Hillcrest neighbourhood, built as part of the 2010 Winter Olympics legacy infrastructure. It sits adjacent to Nat Bailey Stadium and Hillcrest Park, making it a notable landmark on the southeast side of the city. Touring cyclists passing through the area will find it a recognizable civic anchor in a well-connected recreational corridor.
